paper_title: More Tokens, Lower Precision Towards the Optimal Token-Precision   Trade-off in KV Cache Compression
caption: The results of Layer-Wise Quantized Pruning on Mistral-7B-v0.2-Instruct, with SnapKV as pruning method. KV cache budget=1/64.
model_annotation:
The plot illustrates the relative change in performance for different configurations of a model, likely related to quantization and token usage, across several layers. The x-axis is labeled "Layer1-4" to "Layer29-32", representing discrete layer groups, with equal spacing between each label. The y-axis is labeled “Relative Change” and has a linear scale ranging from -25% to 5%, with tick marks at 5% intervals. 

The line colored yellow, marked "LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit", begins at approximately 1.5% at Layer1-4, decreases to approximately -2% at Layer5-12, then increases to approximately -1% at Layer13-20, decreases to approximately -6% at Layer21-28 and remains constant at approximately -6% for Layer29-32. The orange line, labeled "LB-Avg of 1×tokens,8-bit," starts at approximately -1.5% at Layer1-4, rises to approximately 0.5% at Layer5-12, remains at approximately 0.5% at Layer13-20, falls to approximately -4% at Layer21-28, and remains at approximately -4% at Layer29-32.  The light blue line, labeled "RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit," starts at approximately 2.5% at Layer1-4, declines to approximately -14% at Layer13-20, falls sharply to approximately -24% at Layer21-28, and then rises slightly to approximately -22% at Layer29-32. The dark blue line, labeled “RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit,” begins at approximately 1% at Layer1-4, decreases to approximately -8% at Layer13-20, declines further to approximately -18% at Layer21-28, and rises to approximately -13% at Layer29-32. A dotted grey line, labeled "Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit," remains steady at approximately 1.5% across all layer groups.
